svg.text: The A pulley sits high with its teeth on top; the B pulley sits

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: low with its hub on top. If both look the same, one is wrong — and

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no amount of Ch 07 belt tension will fix it. Both use the 20T 6 mm

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pulley; the four 9 mm 20T pulleys are the Z drive's.
